en.content: In the figure, a ladder of mass m is shown leaning against a wall. It is in static equilibrium making an angle with the horizontal floor. The coefficient of friction between the wall and the ladder is 1 and that between the floor and the ladder is 2. The normal reaction of the wall on the ladder is N1 and that of the floor is N2.
